en.headline: Transport Department sets special arrangements at Huanggang control point for Chung Yeung
en.dek: Bus and minibus frequencies will be increased from Saturday as cross-boundary flows rise, with Monday afternoon to evening expected to be the peak return period.
body: The Transport Department said special traffic and public transport arrangements will operate at the newly reopened Huanggang control point from Saturday to handle higher passenger and vehicle flows during the three-day Chung Yeung Festival period.

The department expects land-border crossings to see significant increases from Friday through Monday, with the peak return to Hong Kong likely on Monday afternoon and evening, when waiting times for public transport may lengthen. It has instructed franchised bus, green minibus and cross-boundary bus operators to deploy extra vehicles and staff.

During busy periods, franchised buses can run as frequently as every two to three minutes and minibuses and cross-boundary buses every three to four minutes. The department’s emergency traffic coordination centre will monitor the control point around the clock, with additional staff on site at interchanges and major stops.

Travellers were advised to plan journeys in advance and to use other land or rail crossings if convenient rather than concentrating on the new control point. MTR, high-speed rail and Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge shuttle services will also be strengthened.

zh.headline: 運輸署皇崗口岸重陽節實施特別交通安排 料下周一下午至傍晚為回港高峰
zh.dek: 周六起加密專營巴士及小巴班次，呼籲市民提早計劃行程，按需要選擇其他口岸過關。
body: 運輸署表示，為配合明日起一連三日重陽節假期及人流高峰，皇崗口岸將實施特別交通及公共運輸安排。
署方預計今日起至下周一各陸路口岸人流車流將顯著增加，尤其下周一下午至傍晚為回港高峰，公共運輸等候時間或較長。已督導專營巴士、專線小巴及跨境巴士營辦商增加後備車輛和人手。
繁忙時段專營巴士班次可加密至毂2至3分鐘一班，專線小巴及跨境巴士可加密至毂3至4分鐘一班。緊急事故交通協調中心將24小時監察，並加派人手在交匯處及主要站點實時調配。
運輸署呼籲市民提早計劃行程，按需要選擇合適口岸過關，不必急於使用新口岸。港鐵東鐵線、高鐵及港珠澳大橋穿梭巴士亦會加強服務。
